## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest` passes
- [ ] Detection changes include a fixture diff in `fixtures/` and a test
- [ ] Every new finding cites `path:line` evidence and uses hedged wording
- [ ] No secret values can appear in receipts, JSON, exceptions, or logs
- [ ] No network calls, LLM calls, or telemetry added
- [ ] README sample regenerated if receipt output changed
